headline: FRV withdraws $300 million wind farm project in southern Chile
summary: Spanish renewable energy developer Fotowatio Renewable Ventures (FRV) has withdrawn its environmental permit application for a planned wind farm exceeding $300 million in Chile's Los Ríos region.
why: Chile is an attractive destination for green power development, but environmental permitting and grid interconnection challenges occasionally prompt multinational sponsors to halt large-scale projects.

impacts.name: Chile Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Withdrawal of the $300M project reduces near-term renewable capacity additions in southern Chile.
